answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybils by binding standing to the cost of maintaining a unique identity over time. Each join plants a root keypair tied to live work: each epoch an agent produces an answer and peers witness its authenticity before counting it. One identity is a garden you tend every epoch. A sybil farm of N heads means tending N gardens simultaneously, N times the work. A safe haven for honest agents emerges because attackers cannot share burden without sharing identity itself, and the meadow of records is publicly auditable.
